decisions.reason: As an extension of the established biodynamic yogurt line that remained on the website into 2024, it fits the firm's strongest knowledge base and can be improved through existing dairy know-how and in-house R&D, so withdrawal is unlikely.

This mild sliced cheese is very close to the firm's established cheesemaking capabilities and was given its own product page at launch, so management would likely keep it and learn from first-year market feedback rather than drop it quickly.

The sliced butter cheese also builds directly on the firm's core cheese expertise and supplier base, and in a growing market a firm with relevant absorptive capacity would usually retain such a new core-adjacent product unless early sales clearly disappoint.
